text:
It look like his mum still didn't cut the umbilical cord with his "small son", and he puts mommy above you. Hard situation. You need to set your boudaries, but more important is what your husband will do. He should talk to his mum and show where is the limit. Sadly it look like maybe he even dont want to do anything in this situation. Its his mother, and HE should be the one who cares about resolving the situation.
After getting married wife should be a priority. Not mum. Look like for your husband you are only at the second place.
